title: Single-nuclei RNA-seq of meningioma

publications.title: A microenvironment-determined risk continuum refines subtyping in meningioma and reveals determinants of machine learning-based tumor classification

patient_count: Not reported (26 samples; patient count not distinguished from sample count in series metadata)
needs_manual_review_reason: Series states samples span WHO grades and methylation classes per the summary text, but exact per-grade counts and patient vs. sample distinction were not in series-level metadata; needs per-GSM extraction. Note: series description mentions a decrease in myeloid proportion grade 1->3, indicating grade breakdown data exists in the paper's supplementary tables even though not in the GEO series record itself. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10): publications[0].preprint_id was incorrect and has been corrected to null. DOI 10.64898/2026.04.27.26351840 is NOT a preprint of this Maas et al. paper; it is an unrelated, later secondary-analysis preprint by different authors (Piccolo D, Vindigni M, medRxiv 2026) that merely cites this paper (as reference #8). No genuine preprint of the Maas et al. Nature Genetics paper was found via Europe PMC. Also corrected date_deposited/date_updated: the live GEO record's Series_submission_date is Dec 15 2025 and Series_last_update_date is Feb 18 2026 (previously both incorrectly recorded as the 'Public on' date, 2025-12-23).

gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_h5 of all 26 samples' deposited raw (unfiltered) Cell Ranger .h5 output (GSM9372517-GSM9372542), QC per sample (min 200 genes/cell, <20% pct_counts_mt), anndata.concat (unintegrated), filter_genes min_cells=3 (27552 genes), normalize_total+log1p, top-2000 HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden (resolution 0.5, 24 clusters, igraph flavor). Gene panel: 11 guaranteed meningioma driver genes + top HVGs by dispersion to 100 total (started smaller than other records given 26 samples' likely scale).
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: All 26 samples were merged by raw concatenation, not batch-corrected/integrated (same approach ScPCA documents for its own merged objects) -- use "color by sample" to check for patient-driven rather than biological clustering. 24 Leiden clusters at this scale means several likely resolve to the same broad cell type rather than being 24 distinct identities.
